name: Contractors
description: External contractor companies and sole traders available for facilities management work. Tracks trade disciplines, certifications (Gas Safe, NICEIC), coverage areas, and commercial terms.
record_count_estimate: Medium volume - typically hundreds of contractor records

fields.name: contractor_id
fields.description: Unique auto-incrementing identifier for each contractor

fields.name: company_name
fields.description: Registered company name or sole trader trading name

fields.name: primary_contact_name
fields.description: Name of the main point of contact at the contractor company

fields.name: email
fields.description: Primary email address for business communications

fields.name: phone
fields.description: Primary telephone number in +44 format

fields.name: whatsapp_number
fields.description: WhatsApp number for receiving job notifications and updates in +44 format

fields.name: trade_disciplines
fields.description: Trade disciplines the contractor is qualified to perform

fields.name: coverage_postcodes
fields.description: Comma-separated UK postcode prefixes indicating coverage area (e.g. SW, EC, SE1, W1)

fields.name: gas_safe_number
fields.description: Gas Safe Register number, required for GAS_SAFE discipline work

fields.name: gas_safe_expiry
fields.description: Gas Safe registration expiry date

fields.name: niceic_number
fields.description: NICEIC registration number for electrical contractors

fields.name: niceic_expiry
fields.description: NICEIC registration expiry date

fields.name: other_certifications
fields.description: Additional certifications and accreditations (e.g. CITB, CSCS, F-Gas, IPAF)

fields.name: hourly_rate
fields.description: Standard hourly rate excluding VAT

fields.name: callout_fee
fields.description: Fixed callout fee charged per visit, excluding VAT

fields.name: emergency_available
fields.description: Whether the contractor is available for emergency out-of-hours callouts

fields.name: average_response_hours
fields.description: Historical average response time in hours from job assignment to arrival on site

fields.name: rating
fields.description: Overall performance rating based on quality, timeliness, and communication

fields.name: total_jobs_completed
fields.description: Total number of work items completed by this contractor

fields.name: total_jobs_value
fields.description: Total value of all completed work items in GBP

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the contractor in the system

fields.name: payment_terms
fields.description: Agreed payment terms for invoices

fields.name: xero_contact_id
fields.description: Xero accounting software contact identifier for invoice synchronisation

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Timestamp when the contractor record was created

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Internal notes about the contractor, including any performance issues or special arrangements

fields.name: compliance_status
fields.description: Computed compliance status based on certification expiry dates. Updated daily by Scenario F.

fields.name: next_expiry_date
fields.description: Earliest expiry date across all certifications (gas_safe_expiry, niceic_expiry). Updated daily by Scenario F.

fields.name: compliance_documents
fields.description: Uploaded certification documents (Gas Safe cards, NICEIC certificates, insurance documents). Future: AI vision extraction of expiry dates.

fields.name: compliance_notes
fields.description: Notes about compliance status, renewal reminders, or exemptions

views.name: All Contractors
views.description: Complete list of all contractor records

views.name: Active by Trade
views.description: Active contractors grouped by their trade disciplines

views.name: Gas Safe Certified
views.description: Contractors with valid Gas Safe registration

views.name: Available for Emergency
views.description: Contractors available for emergency out-of-hours work

views.name: Compliance Expiring
views.description: Active contractors with EXPIRING_SOON or EXPIRED compliance status, sorted by nearest expiry date
